moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view looking down on a wooded compound with a long dark building at lower left; haze rolls over it at once.
Thick pale cloud fills most of the view as the sensor drifts; the ground shows only through gaps.
A small bright spot with a short streak behind it crosses from middle left, just above the crosshair, to the upper right. About 1.2 s.
The cloud parts over the compound (tents, pale roofs, the long dark building), with a few blocky picture glitches, then cloud drifts back.
Clear view of the compound: the long dark building with a bright end, dirt tracks, trees and small huts.
Cloud drifts back over the compound and hides it.
The cloud clears again; the compound is turned, the long building now running up the right side.
Cloud covers the view again, with brief glimpses of the ground.
The cloud clears a last time over the compound until the end.

notes: 4:3 picture with side bars (crop applied). Mostly cloud; the only object is the 1.2 s crossing at 0:28.
